description: Na₂CeF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P321 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.82 Å. Ce⁴⁺ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F¹⁻ atoms. There are three shorter (2.20 Å) and six longer (2.38 Å) Ce-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ce⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Ce₂ tetrahedra. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Ce⁴⁺ atom.
